source.counts: BBMP street lights by ward, via OpenCity
source.new_boundaries: Government of Karnataka GBA ward notification, 7 March 2026

method: area apportionment by 4000 samples per new ward. A new ward keeps a figure only where more than 5 percent of it falls inside the old BBMP wards that were counted.
caveat: BBMP counted 198 wards. The GBA area is larger, so wards in the added belt have no source figure and are left null rather than estimated.
